mainEntity.name: What factors influence the cost of deck maintenance or repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of deck maintenance varies based on several factors, including the deck's size, its current condition, the type of wood, the extent of repairs needed, and the specific services chosen (e.g., cleaning, sealing, staining, board replacement). For instance, extensive rot repair or structural reinforcement will be more costly than a simple cleaning and re-sealing. We provide detailed estimates after a thorough inspection, taking into account materials and labor specific to your project in the East Bay area.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cost depends on deck size, condition, wood type, repair extent, and chosen services. Extensive repairs are pricier than basic cleaning. Estimates follow an inspection.
